mechanisms.name: Chat completion request path
mechanisms.trigger: POST /v1/chat/completions, and /v1/chat/completions/batch for several conversations
mechanisms.observable: a validated request is rendered, sized, sent to AsyncLLM.generate, and answered with parsed choices, usage and a fingerprint

mechanisms.name: Chat SSE streaming
mechanisms.trigger: stream=true on a chat request
mechanisms.observable: a role chunk, one delta chunk per engine output with finish_reason on the last, an optional usage chunk, then data: [DONE]; errors become data chunks

mechanisms.name: Text completion request path
mechanisms.trigger: POST /v1/completions
mechanisms.observable: each prompt becomes one engine request, the generators are merged, and choices come back in prompt order, or as an SSE stream

mechanisms.name: Engine liveness and admission preflight
mechanisms.trigger: before a generate response starts, on every generate-family route
mechanisms.observable: a dead engine raises its dead error and an overfull queue raises QueueOverflowError or MaxQueuedTokensError before any success status is sent

mechanisms.name: HTTP middleware chain
mechanisms.trigger: every HTTP request, in the order init_entrypoints_middleware installs them
mechanisms.observable: CORS answers, a missing bearer token gets 401 on guarded prefixes, scaling gets 503, the response carries X-Request-Id, and --middleware plugins wrap the app
mechanisms.note: Authentication, scaling and the X-Request-Id echo run in each route. CORS, --middleware plugins and the debug response-body logger are missing.

mechanisms.name: Client disconnect cancellation
mechanisms.trigger: with_cancellation on a route handler; a disconnect message arrives first
mechanisms.observable: the handler task is cancelled and the load counter drops, so the abandoned request stops consuming the engine

mechanisms.name: In-flight request load counter
mechanisms.trigger: load_aware_call on GPU routes, with --enable-server-load-tracking; read by GET /load
mechanisms.observable: the counter rises when a handler starts and falls after the response, on a handler exception, or on a disconnect

mechanisms.name: Engine death watchdog
mechanisms.trigger: every 5 s while serve_http runs with an engine client
mechanisms.observable: an errored engine that is no longer running sets should_exit and the server stops, unless VLLM_KEEP_ALIVE_ON_ENGINE_DEATH

mechanisms.name: API server graceful shutdown
mechanisms.trigger: the first SIGINT or SIGTERM in serve_http
mechanisms.observable: the engine client stops first (abort at timeout 0, otherwise drain), then uvicorn exits and the watchdog is cancelled; a repeated signal does nothing

mechanisms.name: API server startup sequence
mechanisms.trigger: vllm serve, or the api_server entry module
mechanisms.observable: the socket binds before the engine starts, then the engine client, routes, app state and uvicorn come up; connections are refused until then
mechanisms.note: The bind, build and serve order is modeled. Forkserver preload, parser plugin imports, the SIGTERM init interrupt, set_ulimit and the lifespan GC freeze are missing.

mechanisms.name: Route registration by supported task
mechanisms.trigger: once at build_app, from the engine's supported tasks and the dev-mode and fault-tolerance flags
mechanisms.observable: only routes the model can serve exist: generate, pooling, scoring, speech, scale-out, dev and fault-tolerance groups attach conditionally
mechanisms.note: No interface runs the registration pass; it appears as per-route checks such as check-scale-out and the dev-mode guards.

mechanisms.name: vllm serve mode selection
mechanisms.trigger: vllm serve arguments
mechanisms.observable: --grpc, --headless, the data-parallel load-balancing flags and --api-server-count pick gRPC, headless, DP supervisor, multi-server or single-server mode; conflicting modes raise ValueError
mechanisms.note: The Rust frontend mode (VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND) is missing from the selection.

mechanisms.name: Multi API server launch and supervision
mechanisms.trigger: --api-server-count above 1, or the Rust frontend
mechanisms.observable: one shared socket, bound ZMQ listeners, engines launched, API server processes spawned, and the parent blocks until any process fails or a signal arrives, then shuts them down within the timeout
mechanisms.note: Startup is modeled. wait_for_completion_or_failure is only a return, so a failed process never brings the others down, and the deadline-based shutdown and Rust frontend manager are missing.

mechanisms.name: Peer-load-balanced connection accept
mechanisms.trigger: each readable listening socket when API servers share peer_loads
mechanisms.observable: a server defers accept while it is not the least loaded, publishes its connection count, and backs off 1 s after an accept OSError such as EMFILE

mechanisms.name: Data-parallel supervisor probe and monitor
mechanisms.trigger: --data-parallel-multi-port-external-lb; every probe interval
mechanisms.observable: children spawn per local DP rank; a dead child, or a failed /health probe after ready, shuts everything down by forwarding the signal, then force-kills past the grace period
mechanisms.note: The health routes read a seeded is_ready state. Nothing spawns children, probes them, or shuts them down.

mechanisms.name: SSL certificate hot reload
mechanisms.trigger: --enable-ssl-refresh; a watched key, certificate or CA file changes
mechanisms.observable: the live SSL context reloads the chain or CA without a restart; a reload error is logged and the watcher keeps running

mechanisms.name: Periodic engine stats logging
mechanisms.trigger: every VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL while the HTTP or gRPC server runs with stats on
mechanisms.observable: engine throughput and queue stats appear in the log on each interval until shutdown cancels the task
mechanisms.note: async-llm.do-log-stats exists as an engine-core interface, but no loop or flow drives it.

mechanisms.name: SSE keep-alive comments
mechanisms.trigger: --sse-keep-alive-interval above 0; a chat or completion stream idle for the interval
mechanisms.observable: a ": keep-alive" comment is sent so proxies keep the connection open, without cancelling the pending generator step
mechanisms.note: Only the negative-interval check in cli-args.validate-parsed-serve-args is modeled.

mechanisms.name: ORCA endpoint load report header
mechanisms.trigger: a request carrying the endpoint-load-metrics format header on a non-streaming chat or completion response
mechanisms.observable: the response carries endpoint-load-metrics in TEXT or JSON with kv_cache_usage_perc and num_requests_waiting from the Prometheus gauges

mechanisms.name: Prometheus /metrics and HTTP instrumentation
mechanisms.trigger: GET /metrics; after each non-excluded HTTP response
mechanisms.observable: http_requests_total counts by method, handler and status class, and /metrics serves the registry without an API key

mechanisms.name: Per-request timing metrics in responses
mechanisms.trigger: the server flag for per-request metrics; the response or final usage chunk
mechanisms.observable: the body reports time to first token, generation time, queue time, mean inter-token latency, tokens per second and speculative decoding stats
mechanisms.note: Only the flag check in cli-args.validate-parsed-serve-args mentions it.

mechanisms.name: Tool-call parser invocation counter
mechanisms.trigger: each ToolParser invocation: once per choice non-streaming, once per delta streaming
mechanisms.observable: vllm:tool_call_parser_invocations_total grows by model, mode, outcome and request type; parser failures count as no_tool_call

mechanisms.name: Sleep and weight-transfer operation metrics
mechanisms.trigger: each dev-mode sleep, wake or weight-transfer route
mechanisms.observable: vllm:sleep_mode_operation_* and vllm:rl_weight_update_operation_* report duration and in-flight count by operation

mechanisms.name: Responses API stored conversations
mechanisms.trigger: store=true with VLLM_ENABLE_RESPONSES_API_STORE; a later previous_response_id or GET /v1/responses/{id}
mechanisms.observable: a response and its messages are kept in memory forever and can continue a conversation or be retrieved; unknown ids get 404

mechanisms.name: Background response lifecycle
mechanisms.trigger: background=true on POST /v1/responses; cancel or retrieve later
mechanisms.observable: a stored response moves queued to in_progress to completed, failed or cancelled; a cancel stops the task; stream retrieval replays the event store from starting_after
mechanisms.note: Non-streaming queued, failed and cancelled states are modeled. The event store, background stream and starting_after replay are missing.

mechanisms.name: Responses API streaming events
mechanisms.trigger: stream=true on POST /v1/responses
mechanisms.observable: typed events flow in order (response.created, output item and content deltas, done events, response.completed) as SSE, for text, reasoning, function calls and tools
mechanisms.note: openai-serving-responses.create-responses has no stream branch.

mechanisms.name: Responses built-in tool turn loop
mechanisms.trigger: the model asks for a built-in tool during a Responses request
mechanisms.observable: the tool runs, its output joins the context, the prompt re-renders, and a new sub-request <id>_<n> generates, until no tool call remains
mechanisms.note: openai-serving-responses.responses-full-generator models one turn and says so.

mechanisms.name: MCP and demo tool server
mechanisms.trigger: --tool-server at startup; a tool call opens a session
mechanisms.observable: MCP servers are discovered over SSE (initialize, list tools), their schemas are trimmed for Harmony, and each call opens a session with x-session-id; the demo server validates its python and browser tools

mechanisms.name: Parser class composition
mechanisms.trigger: once when a serving class is built, from --tool-call-parser, --reasoning-parser and the model
mechanisms.observable: Harmony, the hf response-template parser, KimiK3, Cohere, MiniCPM-V or a composed DelegatingParser is chosen; hf cannot combine with others; the result is validated against the tokenizer

mechanisms.name: Tool-call extraction from complete output
mechanisms.trigger: a non-streaming chat response with tools
mechanisms.observable: tool_choice none keeps content, a named choice wraps the content as arguments, and auto runs the model's ToolParser into structured tool_calls with finish_reason tool_calls
mechanisms.note: Hermes, Llama 3 JSON and the engine path are modeled. The other format-specific parsers among about 50 are not.

mechanisms.name: Streaming tool-call deltas
mechanisms.trigger: each streamed chat delta with tools
mechanisms.observable: tool names are sent once and arguments stream as growing JSON, with reasoning split out first; named and required tool_choice have their own streaming extractors
mechanisms.note: The DelegatingParser path and the Qwen3 engine config are modeled. Other streaming parsers and the required-tool span scanner are not.

mechanisms.name: ParserEngine terminal state machine
mechanisms.trigger: engine-based parsers, on each token batch or whole output
mechanisms.observable: token ids pass a scanner and incremental lexer, marker terminals drive (state, terminal) transitions, and events carry content, reasoning and tool arguments, with partial markers held back
mechanisms.note: Whole-text transitions and a few model configs are modeled. The token-id scanner and incremental lexer holdback are not.

mechanisms.name: Reasoning output extraction
mechanisms.trigger: a chat response with --reasoning-parser
mechanisms.observable: thinking text moves to the reasoning field, split from content both whole and per delta, and the end of reasoning is detected from token ids
mechanisms.note: DeepSeek V3 and GLM-4.7 are modeled. Most reasoning parsers are not.

mechanisms.name: Harmony channel parsing
mechanisms.trigger: a gpt-oss model, on chat or Responses output
mechanisms.observable: Harmony messages split by channel and recipient into reasoning, content and tool calls, and the Responses context keeps the message list across turns
mechanisms.note: Chat delta parsing is modeled. Harmony prompt rendering, HarmonyContext and the Responses tool path are missing.

mechanisms.name: Response-template parser
mechanisms.trigger: --tool-call-parser hf or --reasoning-parser hf
mechanisms.observable: the tokenizer's response template drives a streaming parser that assigns output to content, reasoning and tool fields
mechanisms.note: get-parser only selects the class name. Neither the template parser nor its validation is modeled.

mechanisms.name: Tool structural-tag constraints
mechanisms.trigger: a chat request with tools, by tool_choice, tool strict flags and --tool-strict-level
mechanisms.observable: adjust_request attaches a structural tag or JSON schema so decoding is constrained; the server floor can force strictness on tools
mechanisms.note: tool_choice schemas in adjust_request are modeled. The strict-level floor and per-model structural-tag registry are not.

mechanisms.name: Chat rendering and tokenization
mechanisms.trigger: each chat request, render route and tokenize-chat call
mechanisms.observable: messages and content parts are parsed, the template applied, the text tokenized, and token ids plus multimodal features returned; bad tool_choice or template input gets 400

mechanisms.name: Chat template resolution and format caches
mechanisms.trigger: the first render per template and tools presence
mechanisms.observable: the template is chosen from request, processor, tokenizer or the model-type fallback; AST inspection picks string or openai content format; failed processor lookups stay cached
mechanisms.note: Trust checks and the developer-role fallback are modeled. Template selection order, content-format detection and the caches are not; the model renders by a fixed template family.

mechanisms.name: Chat template render timeout and pool swap
mechanisms.trigger: a render exceeding VLLM_CHAT_TEMPLATE_RENDER_TIMEOUT
mechanisms.observable: the request fails with TimeoutError and the renderer pool is replaced, so a stuck template thread cannot block later requests

mechanisms.name: Renderer thread-pool isolation
mechanisms.trigger: each tokenize, decode or multimodal render
mechanisms.observable: tokenization runs on a pool of renderer_num_workers with per-worker tokenizer copies, and multimodal work on one thread, so tokenization never queues behind media processing
mechanisms.note: process-multimodal names the single-worker executor in its text, but no queueing, capacity or tokenizer copy is simulated.

mechanisms.name: Background multimodal processor warmup
mechanisms.trigger: renderer startup, overlapping engine init
mechanisms.observable: warmup runs on the single-worker multimodal executor and is joined by the first reset, warmup or shutdown, so it never overlaps a serving request

mechanisms.name: Multimodal chat input processing
mechanisms.trigger: a chat request with image, video or embeds parts
mechanisms.observable: each part is tracked in order, media is fetched and limited, the processor expands placeholders, and token ids and features reach the engine request

mechanisms.name: Prompt length and token limits
mechanisms.trigger: after rendering each prompt
mechanisms.observable: over-long prompts get 400 unless truncation applies, token ids outside the vocabulary are refused, multimodal truncation is limited, and max_tokens is capped by the remaining context

mechanisms.name: Sampling parameter resolution
mechanisms.trigger: each generate request and each offline call
mechanisms.observable: request values override generation-config defaults, then limits, stop tokens and structured-output settings are validated or filled in; bad values get 400

mechanisms.name: Request body validation chain
mechanisms.trigger: parsing each chat, completion, batch or token request body
mechanisms.observable: pydantic before-validators run in order and refuse inconsistent fields with 400 before any engine work

mechanisms.name: Served model and adapter resolution
mechanisms.trigger: each request, from its model field
mechanisms.observable: a served name selects the base model, a loaded adapter rides on the engine request, a registered resolver may load one on demand, and an unknown name gets 404
mechanisms.note: Served names and loaded adapters are modeled. On-demand loading through LoRAResolver is missing.

mechanisms.name: LoRA adapter load and unload
mechanisms.trigger: POST /v1/load_lora_adapter or /v1/unload_lora_adapter, and --lora-modules at startup
mechanisms.observable: an adapter is loaded on all workers under a per-name lock, then served and listed; unloading only drops it from the served set; an in-place reload keeps its id
mechanisms.note: Runtime load and unload are modeled. Static --lora-modules loading at startup is missing.

mechanisms.name: Exception to error response mapping
mechanisms.trigger: any exception from a handler or validation
mechanisms.observable: each exception class maps to an OpenAI-shaped error and status; engine errors also run terminate_if_errored so the server can stop; a generation error becomes 500 or an SSE error chunk

mechanisms.name: vllm run-batch file processing
mechanisms.trigger: vllm run-batch with an input file
mechanisms.observable: every line routes by its URL's last segment and runs concurrently; errors become error lines; results are written to a local file or uploaded
mechanisms.note: Routing and concurrent requests are modeled, with run-request limited to chat-shaped handlers. Remote read_file and write_file are missing.

mechanisms.name: Batch output upload retry
mechanisms.trigger: an http(s) --output-file after a batch
mechanisms.observable: the PUT is tried up to 5 times with a 5 s delay and a 1000 s timeout; after the last failure the run raises

mechanisms.name: Transcription and translation pipeline
mechanisms.trigger: POST /v1/audio/transcriptions or /v1/audio/translations
mechanisms.observable: audio is decoded and split on a bounded executor, language is detected from the first chunk, each chunk becomes an engine request, and results join into text, verbose segments or an SSE stream
mechanisms.note: Only run-batch.transcription-wrapper reaches these handlers, as a call boundary.

mechanisms.name: Realtime transcription WebSocket session
mechanisms.trigger: a WebSocket connection to /v1/realtime
mechanisms.observable: session.created is sent, session.update validates the model, audio appends queue up, commit starts generation, and transcription deltas and done events stream until the final commit; WebSocket metrics follow the connection

mechanisms.name: Beam search in the frontend
mechanisms.trigger: use_beam_search on /v1/completions, or LLM.beam_search
mechanisms.observable: each step sends every live beam as a one-token request, keeps the best extensions by length-penalized score, and returns the best beams

mechanisms.name: Offline LLM batch run loop
mechanisms.trigger: LLM.generate, chat, enqueue or wait_for_completion
mechanisms.observable: requests render and join the engine, the caller steps until nothing is unfinished, and outputs return sorted by request id

mechanisms.name: Offline pooling tiling loop
mechanisms.trigger: LLM.encode, embed, classify or score
mechanisms.observable: at most max_num_seqs * 2 requests sit in the core, refilled as requests finish, so huge inputs render lazily; added requests abort on an exception
mechanisms.note: The model adds fixed windows and steps until each finishes, by its own stated assumption, instead of refilling as requests finish.

mechanisms.name: Online pooling request pipeline
mechanisms.trigger: POST /v1/embeddings, /v2/embed, /classify or /pooling
mechanisms.observable: a context is built, prompts render concurrently, one encode runs per prompt and merges, and the IO processor builds the task's response with usage

mechanisms.name: Chunked embedding of long inputs
mechanisms.trigger: pooler enable_chunked_processing with a prompt over max_model_len
mechanisms.observable: the prompt splits into max_model_len chunks, each encoded separately, then token-weighted mean aggregation yields one embedding, normalized when all chunks were

mechanisms.name: Scoring mode selection
mechanisms.trigger: POST /score or /rerank (v1, v2)
mechanisms.observable: the pooling task picks bi-encoder, cross-encoder or late interaction; inputs and per-query token limits are validated; scores return sorted for rerank

mechanisms.name: Worker-side late-interaction MaxSim
mechanisms.trigger: flash late interaction enabled on a token_embed scoring model
mechanisms.observable: queries encode first and cache token embeddings on workers, then documents encode and return scalar scores; a failure cleans up the worker query cache
mechanisms.note: serving-scores.serve-score models late interaction only as the plain token_embed path.

mechanisms.name: Generative label scoring
mechanisms.trigger: POST /generative_scoring
mechanisms.observable: one prompt per item generates one token with label logprobs, and softmax over the labels returns each item's probabilities

mechanisms.name: Structured decision read strategies
mechanisms.trigger: POST /v1/systemone
mechanisms.observable: the model architecture selects a read strategy; a model without one gets 501; question types are read into typed answers
mechanisms.note: Selection and gating are modeled. The model states that strategy.read's numeric scoring is not simulated.

mechanisms.name: SageMaker invocation dispatch
mechanisms.trigger: POST /invocations; GET or POST /ping
mechanisms.observable: the JSON body is tried against each enabled request type in order and routed to that handler; no match gets 400; ping answers like /health

mechanisms.name: Anthropic Messages translation
mechanisms.trigger: POST /v1/messages and /v1/messages/count_tokens
mechanisms.observable: the request converts to chat form (system, tools, thinking, images), runs the chat handler, and converts back, including an SSE block event stream and token counting
mechanisms.note: Conversion and the non-streaming reply are modeled. message_stream_converter returns the chat events without block events, and the disabled-thinking probe is missing.

mechanisms.name: Cohere v2 chat translation
mechanisms.trigger: POST /cohere/v2/chat and /render, with VLLM_ENABLE_COHERE_API
mechanisms.observable: a Cohere request renders through melody and the chat handler, the reply gains citations from numbered slots, and errors take Cohere's shape
mechanisms.note: Routes, role mapping and citation numbering are modeled. The route forwards only model, messages and max_tokens to the chat handler, and the SSE stream state machine is missing.

mechanisms.name: Scale-out render, tokens and derender
mechanisms.trigger: render-only server or --tokens-only; POST */render, /inference/v1/generate and */derender
mechanisms.observable: a render tier tokenizes and returns a GenerateRequest, an inference tier generates token ids, and a derender tier parses tokens back into a response, keeping stream state in the client's payload
mechanisms.note: Non-streaming tiers and the chat stream delta step are modeled. Multimodal cache handle validation, feature transfer and the completion stream are not.

mechanisms.name: Rejected remote-prefill cleanup
mechanisms.trigger: a do_remote_prefill request that errors before reaching the engine
mechanisms.observable: the KV connector is told the request was rejected, so pinned remote blocks are freed; a failed notification is only logged

mechanisms.name: Elastic EP scale gate
mechanisms.trigger: POST /scale_elastic_ep
mechanisms.observable: the body is validated, every HTTP request gets 503 while scaling, the client prepares, drains and commits, and a drain timeout gets its own error

mechanisms.name: Fault-tolerance apply and status
mechanisms.trigger: POST /fault_tolerance/apply; GET /fault_tolerance/status
mechanisms.observable: only retry is accepted; the route answers 202 and recovery runs in the background, so the orchestrator can dispatch every rank and poll status

mechanisms.name: RL pause, weight update and resume
mechanisms.trigger: dev-mode /pause, /start_weight_update, /update_weights, /finish_weight_update and /resume, or the LLM methods
mechanisms.observable: generation pauses (abort, wait or keep), weights transfer to workers, the finish step stamps a version, and generation resumes

mechanisms.name: Dev-mode engine control routes
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE; sleep, wake, cache reset, collective_rpc, server_info and profile routes
mechanisms.observable: each route forwards to the engine client; without dev mode the routes do not exist; server_info hides names containing KEY and caches system info

mechanisms.name: Out-of-band request abort
mechanisms.trigger: POST /inference/v1/abort_requests, /abort_requests, or dev-mode /abort_requests
mechanisms.observable: the given ids abort in the background and the route answers 200 at once; dev mode can abort everything tracked

mechanisms.name: Per-request routing headers
mechanisms.trigger: X-Vllm-Priority, X-data-parallel-rank and session-id on a generate request
mechanisms.observable: the priority header overrides the body, and rank and session id reach the engine request to pin its data-parallel rank and session
mechanisms.note: Priority is modeled. Data-parallel rank and session id routing are not.

mechanisms.name: gRPC server lifecycle
mechanisms.trigger: vllm serve --grpc
mechanisms.observable: AsyncLLM and the gRPC engine, health and reflection services start; a signal marks health NOT_SERVING, stops the server with 5 s grace, then stops the engine
mechanisms.note: Startup and the stop order are modeled. RPC handling, the health servicer, its NOT_SERVING step and stats logging are not.

mechanisms.name: Weight cache preload daemons
mechanisms.trigger: vllm preload
mechanisms.observable: one daemon per GPU per role starts and reports over a ready queue; /health turns 200 once all are ready; a daemon exiting during startup terminates all with its exit code
mechanisms.note: Only /health over seeded state is modeled. Nothing spawns daemons, collects readiness or handles an early exit.

mechanisms.name: vllm snapshot command gate
mechanisms.trigger: vllm snapshot create, inspect or restore
mechanisms.observable: create refuses anything but one unauthenticated plaintext TP1 server on Linux x86_64 with an immutable remote revision, then hands over to the snapshot controller
mechanisms.note: config-platform models snapshot-server, but the CLI gate and its dispatch are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: vllm bench subcommand dispatch
mechanisms.trigger: vllm bench <serve|latency|throughput|sweep|startup|mm-processor>
mechanisms.observable: the subcommand runs its benchmark module; mm_processor reports processor timing

mechanisms.name: vllm CLI dispatch and chat client
mechanisms.trigger: vllm <subcommand>; vllm chat or vllm complete
mechanisms.observable: argv picks a subcommand, which validates and runs; the client picks the first listed model and streams replies; download-kernels installs FlashInfer kernels

mechanisms.name: Tokenize and detokenize routes
mechanisms.trigger: POST /tokenize, /detokenize; GET /tokenizer_info with its flag
mechanisms.observable: a prompt or chat gives token ids through the renderer, and ids give text; continuation and generation-prompt conflicts get 400

mechanisms.name: Tokenizer registry and caches
mechanisms.trigger: first get_tokenizer per argument set; each later lookup
mechanisms.observable: the mode selects the class, one lru-cached instance serves the process, and the HF wrapper caches special ids, vocab and max token id

mechanisms.name: Incremental detokenization
mechanisms.trigger: each new output token in the output processor or stream derenderer
mechanisms.observable: new text is produced from a prefix window, so multi-byte and merged tokens emit only when stable, with leading spaces restored
mechanisms.note: engine-core's update models stop-string handling over stand-in token text. The prefix-window algorithm is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Hub metadata fetch with retry
mechanisms.trigger: get_config, list_repo_files and safetensors metadata reads
mechanisms.observable: transient failures retry with doubling delay, fatal errors raise at once, and offline mode lists no files; this tolerates a cache refresh hiding config.json
mechanisms.note: model-config.post-init fetches the config once and has no retry path.

mechanisms.name: Model config format dispatch and overrides
mechanisms.trigger: get_config at startup and tokenizer load
mechanisms.observable: auto detection picks the HF or Mistral parser, registered formats extend it, and speculators and rope patches rewrite the config; a missing config gets a ValueError with guidance
mechanisms.note: The missing-config error, speculators override and pickling registration are modeled. Parser selection and rope patching are not.

mechanisms.name: Model architecture config convertors
mechanisms.trigger: building the model arch config from an HF config
mechanisms.observable: the model type selects a convertor that normalizes head size, layers, experts and rope across about 30 model families
mechanisms.note: model-config.get-head-size mentions ModelArchConfig but does not run the per-type dispatch.

mechanisms.name: Object storage model mirror
mechanisms.trigger: a model path in S3 or another RunAI-streamed store
mechanisms.observable: config files pull into a hashed local cache directory, removed on SIGINT or SIGTERM when VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE_MODEL_CLEAN is set

mechanisms.name: HF processor and feature extractor caches
mechanisms.trigger: first multimodal processor, image, video or feature-extractor load
mechanisms.observable: lru caches keep one loaded processor per argument set, using hashable wrappers for kwargs
mechanisms.note: The interface delegates to the context, with no cache behavior.

mechanisms.name: Request and output logging
mechanisms.trigger: --enable-log-requests and --enable-log-outputs; debug response logging
mechanisms.observable: request parameters, bodies and generated text are logged, truncated to --max-log-len, with streaming deltas marked
mechanisms.note: Only the flag check in cli-args.validate-parsed-serve-args mentions it.
